name: GL_PERIOD_STATUSES_
description: GL_PERIOD_STATUSES contains the statuses of your accounting periods. Each row includes the accounting period name and status. Many applications maintain their calendars in this table, so each row also includes the relevant application identifier. CLOSING_STATUS is either 'O' for Open, 'F' for Future Enterable, 'C' for Closed, 'P' for Permanently Closed, or 'N' for Never Opened. Note that you cannot successfully open a period in your Oracle General Ledger application by changing a period's status to 'O' if it has never been opened before. You must use the Open and Close Periods form or programs to properly open a period.
